d:
Israil ke aam chunav men binyamin netanyahu ka gathbandhan sabse bara gathbandhan to bana hai. magar sarkar banane ke lie jitni siten chahie hoti hain, utni netanyahu ko mil nahin paee hain.
Israil ke chunav men arab deshon ki bhi nazar hain. aise men arab ka midiya israili chunavon par kya kah raha hai?
Vidiyo edit: sadaf khan
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
